steps.en: Run the official Docker image with a data volume and a refresh schedule
steps.zh: 用官方 Docker 镜像跑起来，挂数据卷、设刷新时间

steps.en: Finish the web installer: pick a database and create your user
steps.zh: 走完网页安装向导：选数据库，建用户

steps.en: Subscribe to feeds or import your OPML file
steps.zh: 订阅 feed，或导入你的 OPML 文件

steps.en: Refreshes every feed on schedule (or on WebSub push) and stores new articles
steps.zh: 按时刷新所有 feed（或收到 WebSub 推送即刷），存下新文章

steps.en: Allow API access, set an API password, and add the server to your phone app
steps.zh: 打开 API 访问、设 API 密码，在手机应用里填上服务器

steps.en: Serves articles and keeps read/starred state in sync across web and every app
steps.zh: 提供文章，并在网页和所有应用之间同步已读/星标状态

value.en: One feed list and one read state, on a server you own, shared by every device and client app
value.zh: 一份订阅、一份已读状态，放在你自己的服务器上，所有设备和客户端共用

sources: Docker/README.md Quick run @ edge 2026-10-08: docker run ... -e CRON_MIN=1,31 ... freshrss/freshrss:edge; 'With an automatic cron job to refresh feeds'
README.md Manual install: 'Access FreshRSS with your browser and follow the installation process'; Requirements: PostgreSQL 10+ or SQLite or MariaDB 10.6+ or MySQL 8.0+
README.md: WebSub instant push; APIs & native apps: Google Reader API (best) and Fever API
docs/en/users/06_Mobile_access.md: enable 'Allow API access (required for mobile apps)'; fill 'API password'; link like https://rss.example.net/api/
